event_text: KEPCO says about 24,000 employees' data was exposed on an external webpage (the October breach)
notes: Date from Aju Press and Yonhap, relaying KEPCO.

event_text: The October count rises to 35,528 people, including retirees and partner-company staff
notes: Figures from KEPCO via a legislator's office.

event_text: KEPCO says it becomes aware of the new leak, blocks outside IP access and suspends services
KEPCO announces the leak of 1,520,248 users' data from KEPCO ON and SRM
notes: Earliest outlet we read (Electronic Times) is stamped 6:28 PM Korea time.

event_text: KEPCO posts a public apology and a KEPCO ON leak notice on its website, saying a cyber intrusion caused the leak and police were asked to investigate
notes: Both notices dated Nov 22; no time given.
